# Vendored: ipsae.py

Pinned copy of the ipSAE scoring script, used by `diffab/tools/eval/ipsae.py`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Upstream | https://github.com/DunbrackLab/IPSAE |
| File | `ipsae.py` |
| Commit | `6174cf9e71cb1bd660cc805856a18c4871a6dec3` (2026-01-03) |
| Script version | 4 |
| Retrieved | 2026-09-10 |
| License | MIT (see `LICENSE`) |

Paper: Dunbrack, *Rēs ipSAE loquuntur: What's wrong with AlphaFold's ipTM score
and how to fix it*, bioRxiv 2025.02.10.637595.

## Why vendored rather than submoduled or downloaded

A published metric has to be reproducible years later, and the workstation runs
without assuming network access. The script has no pip package and no importable
API, so there is nothing to depend on -- it is invoked as a subprocess.

**Do not edit this file.** To take an upstream update, re-download it, bump the
commit and date above, and re-run the verification in
`EVALUATION_METRICS.md` -- the AF2 JSON/PDB contract that
`diffab/tools/fold/esmfold2.py` writes against is defined by this script's
parsing code, not by its documentation.

## The contract this copy implements

    python ipsae.py <pae_file> <structure_file> <pae_cutoff> <dist_cutoff>

Mode is chosen by extension sniffing; we use the AF2 path (`.json` + `.pdb`).
It reads `pae`/`predicted_aligned_error`, and optional `plddt`, `ptm`, `iptm`
from the JSON -- pLDDT is never read from PDB B-factors. From the PDB it takes
CA atoms in file order for the PAE index, and CB atoms (CA for glycine) for the
distance matrix. Outputs land beside the structure file as
`<stem>_<pae>_<dist>.txt`, `_byres.txt` and `.pml`.
